classification_method: Exact case-insensitive Windows path equality with the two binary paths in step arguments; no prefix exclusions. Diagnostic ancestry independently confirms observed engines descend through venv launcher -> real Python -> Regicide.
delta_method: For each PID + recorded creation time + exact path, sum nonnegative cumulative CPU differences between successive observations. Do not count initial CPU at first observation. Attribute each difference to its endpoint snapshot phase/step; mark cross-phase and missing-snapshot intervals explicitly.
raw_flag_false_positive_explanation: Runner excluded only direct children of the recorded venv launcher. On Windows the venv launcher spawned the real Python process, which spawned both measured engines. Owned engine CPU therefore remained in raw external snapshots and could set the raw flag. Separate real external engines also consumed CPU; the raw flag must not be discarded as wholly false.
limits: Only sampled Regicide process CPU is observed; other applications, OS scheduling, thermal/power state and CPU placement are not measured.
Polling is approximately 5 seconds plus query/write overhead. CPU between observations is interval-censored; an endpoint bucket is not an exact instant of computation.
CPU seconds are summed across process threads and are not wall-clock delay or proof of benchmark slowdown.
First-observed CPU is omitted, and work after a process last appears cannot be recovered. Processes born and exited between snapshots may be absent.
No load-based game exclusion, result replacement, rerun, engine modification or user process termination was performed.
Node/score comparisons are distinct from wall-clock and timed strength results. External computation limits claims of exclusive same-resource timing and general strength.
